recognize_zh: H&E 淋巴結切片中可見大量小淋巴球與漿細胞，其間散布成群、胞質淡染豐富的大型組織球，部分組織球內隱約可見被包入的淋巴球，提示 Rosai-Dorfman 病，但此放大倍率下擴張的淋巴竇與胞吞現象並不清楚。
features: Dense polymorphous infiltrate of small lymphocytes with numerous plasma cells
Scattered aggregates of large histiocytes with abundant pale eosinophilic to clear cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei
Occasional histiocytes appear to contain small lymphocytes within the cytoplasm (emperipolesis), not well resolved at this power
Thin fibrous septa and small vessels traversing the infiltrate
Nodal sinus architecture is not clearly appreciable in this field
describe_en: H&E section of lymph node at intermediate power shows a dense mixed infiltrate of small lymphocytes and plasma cells with scattered aggregates of large histiocytes having abundant pale cytoplasm and round vesicular nuclei. A few histiocytes appear to harbor intracytoplasmic lymphocytes, although emperipolesis is not well resolved at this magnification. Dilated sinuses are not clearly demonstrated in this particular field. The findings are suggestive of Rosai-Dorfman disease, best confirmed by higher-power demonstration of emperipolesis and S100-positive, CD1a-negative histiocytes.

ddx.vs: The mixed background contains diagnostic Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells (CD30+/CD15+) rather than bland S100+ histiocytes with emperipolesis.
Features sinusoidal Langerhans cells with grooved nuclei and abundant eosinophils, CD1a/langerin positive.
Sinus histiocytes are smaller, S100 negative and lack emperipolesis, with preserved nodal architecture.
